hosting_provider: Sinergise / AWS Registry of Open Data
source_kind_note: Dense Copernicus partner DSM data; not NASA SRTM and not visualization-only AWS Terrarium. Existing cached NASA SRTM analysis stays independent.

coordinate_reference.raster_type: RasterPixelIsPoint; use actual GDAL transform including half-pixel offset.

processing_note: AWS COG conversion removes shared south/east edge rows/columns from original1201x1201 grids. Actual COGs are1200x1200 Float32 at3arcsec. No derived terrain/scoring arrays are in this acquisition manifest.

quality_rules.invalid: Exclude nonfinite elevations and pixels whose EDM==0 or FLM==0. Honor actual raster mask/nodata. These GLO90 DEM files declare no scalar nodata; do not invent a zero-elevation or -32767 fill convention.
quality_rules.interpretation: Water codes identify edited/flattened water-surface elevations, not lake-floor bathymetry. DSM includes vegetation/buildings; report filled/edited/water fractions. Masks do not establish mineralogy.

pilots.name: Craters of the Moon volcanic field

attribution_note: Preserve EULA and its adapted-product attribution; official collection page supplies current required credit notices.
limitations: DSM, not a bare-earth field survey.
Common aggregation area does not remove sensor,epoch,infill,vertical-error or native-response differences.
No rover-hazard certification or field validation.
